get_models: fetch the list of supported models from the OCP API using the async Client.get_models method
get_bulks: fetch the list of supported bulk materials from the OCP API using the async Client.get_bulks method
get_slabs: get a unique list of slabs for a given bulk structure using the async Client.get_slabs method
submit_adsorbate_slab_relaxations: submit adsorbate slab relaxation jobs to the OCP API using the async Client.submit_adsorbate_slab_relaxations method
get_adsorbate_slab_relaxations_results: fetch relaxation results for a system by ID using the async Client.get_adsorbate_slab_relaxations_results method
